VPS Setup Guide

Connecting to Your Quant VPS from a Mac or Apple Device

This is the Apple companion to the Windows Remote Desktop guide. On a Mac you connect through the Windows App by Microsoft. The same steps apply on iPhone and iPad; it is the same app and the same flow.

If you wish to see the walkthrough video, you can watch it here. Otherwise, the steps below have you covered. Your progress is saved on this device.

0 of 5 steps complete

Tick each step as you go.

  1. 1

    Download and open the Windows App

    0:22

    The Windows App by Microsoft is how a Mac connects to your Windows VPS. On a PC this is built in, but on a Mac or Apple device you install it once, free, then open it.

    1. Install the Windows App (by Microsoft) free from the Mac App Store.
    2. On iPhone or iPad, install the same app from the App Store; the steps that follow are the same.
    3. Once it is installed, open the app.
    Get it here: Windows App on the Mac App Store.
    0:22
  2. 2

    Click the plus sign and choose Add PC

    0:27

    Adding a PC saves your VPS so it is ready to connect any time without retyping the address.

    1. Click the little plus sign in the top right of the Windows App.
    2. Choose Add PC from the menu.
    3. In the PC name field, type your VPS IP address (for example 23.5.6.3...).
    Your IP address is listed under Server Credentials in your QuantVPS Control Panel, with a copy button next to it.
    0:27
  3. 3

    Add your credentials (they save automatically)

    1:07

    Adding your credentials here means the VPS knows who you are, and you will not have to enter them every time you connect.

    1. In the Add PC window, find the User account (Credentials) drop-down that says Ask when required.
    2. Open that drop-down and choose Add Credentials.
    3. For Username, enter Administrator. Your VPS username is always Administrator.
    4. For Password, enter the password QuantVPS gave you (from Server Credentials in your Control Panel).
    5. Click Add. Your credentials are saved automatically.
    6. Back on the Add PC window, click Add to finish saving the connection.
    1:07
  4. 4

    Double-click your connection to connect

    1:20

    Your VPS now appears as a saved connection in the Windows App. From here, connecting is a single double-click.

    1. Your server appears as a connection tile under Devices / Saved Devices.
    2. Double-click that tile to connect to your VPS.
    1:20
  5. 5

    You are in

    4:23

    Once your credentials are accepted, the Windows App loads your Windows server desktop, where NinjaTrader and your other trading tools live.

    1. If asked to confirm the connection, click the red Continue button.
    2. Your Windows Server desktop will load, giving you full access.
    3. You are now ready for the NinjaTrader startup process on the server.
    4:23

  6. You are connected

    Your Mac is now connected to your Quant VPS through the Windows App. Because your credentials are saved, future connections are a single double-click. From here you are ready for the NinjaTrader startup process on the server.
